research_questions: What manual workarounds do small business owners describe for handling high volumes of WhatsApp customer chats (labels, multiple phones, forwarding messages between staff)?
What complaints recur about WhatsApp Business numbers getting banned or restricted during outreach and bulk messaging?
Which order-tracking, payment-confirmation, or lead-logging tasks do people say they still do in spreadsheets or notebooks because WhatsApp lacks the feature?
What frustrations come up repeatedly about sharing one WhatsApp Business number across multiple team members or devices?
What recurring problems do developers report with WhatsApp message template submissions, rejections, and category changes?
What complaints appear about business verification, display name approval, phone number registration, and migrating numbers between BSPs?
Which webhook and message-status issues (missing callbacks, duplicates, latency) are posted repeatedly?
What confusion recurs around conversation-based pricing, billing reconciliation, and unexpected charges?
Which WhatsApp Cloud API integration errors dominate questions (access token expiry, webhook verification failures, media upload/download issues)?
What workarounds do developers build for things the API does not natively support, such as scheduling messages, bulk sends, or chat assignment?
What recurring pain appears around template parameter formatting, localization, and variable mismatches?
What questions repeat about handling inbound media, replies, and conversation state at scale?
In unofficial WhatsApp libraries (Baileys, whatsapp-web.js, whatsmeow), what breakage patterns recur after WhatsApp updates (pairing failures, session loss, multi-device sync bugs)?
How do users describe hitting rate limits or number bans, and what operational behaviors triggered them?
Which missing capabilities do users repeatedly request (history sync, group management, catalog/product messages, broadcast lists)?
What maintenance burden do maintainers describe in keeping automation running reliably for businesses?
What do reviewers of WhatsApp engagement platforms (WATI, respond.io, AiSensy, Interakt) name as missing or broken integrations (CRM, Shopify, HubSpot, Google Sheets)?
What complaints recur about per-conversation pricing, hidden costs, and billing surprises?
Which manual steps do support and sales teams say they still perform inside these tools (chat assignment, tagging, exporting reports)?
What onboarding pain is mentioned around template approval, number setup, and Meta verification?
What operational failures do customers report for WhatsApp API providers and BSPs (360dialog, Twilio, MessageBird): downtime, slow template approvals, sudden account suspensions?
What billing, refund, and support-response disputes recur across providers?
What do reviewers say about number bans or quality-rating drops and how providers handled them?
What WhatsApp-related tasks do businesses hire freelancers to automate (bulk messaging, chatbot flows, order notifications, appointment reminders)?
What manual data movement do job posts describe (exporting chats to spreadsheets, copying WhatsApp leads into a CRM, reconciling orders from chat)?
Which integrations are repeatedly requested in job posts (Zapier, Google Sheets, Shopify, HubSpot, payment links)?
What compliance or ban-avoidance requirements show up in postings, indicating pain with WhatsApp's limits?
What pain do merchants describe around WhatsApp order confirmations, COD verification, shipping updates, and abandoned cart recovery?
What complaints recur about connecting WhatsApp to Shopify (app costs, template approval delays, number bans, duplicate notifications)?
Which customer-communication tasks do merchants say they still do manually over WhatsApp every day?
What do WhatsApp Business app reviewers complain about most: label limits, away/greeting message constraints, catalog management, multi-device reliability?
Which feature requests recur (message scheduling, richer auto-replies, multiple admins, better analytics)?
What operational disruptions do reviewers describe (account bans, verification loops, lost chat history when changing phones)?
